declaredBreaks.reason: AI agent thread responses (thread create, get and list, and the SDK LightdashAiAgentThread type) now return firstMessage as null for a thread created with a binding or threadContext and no prompt. Creating such a thread was rejected before, so existing threads and threads created with a prompt still return a firstMessage. API clients and SDK hosts that pre-create threads this way must handle null until the first message is sent.
